lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚下的土不配我踩。
lines.en: I glide; the dirt is unworthy of my feet.

lines.zh: 一点一点飘过去，我不着急。
lines.en: I drift across, unhurried.
This small body is enough.

lines.zh: 红眼睛扫过树梢，我在找猎物。
lines.en: Red eyes sweep the treetops for prey.

lines.zh: 碎石被我的气推着滚开。
lines.en: Gravel rolls aside from my aura.
I do not walk. I hover.
I drift past the ridge unseen.
Hands behind my back, strolling.
My shadow slides over the canopy.

lines.zh: 身子轻，飘起来没什么声音。
lines.en: This light body makes almost no sound.

lines.zh: 慢点走，让他们先怕起来。
lines.en: I go slowly, to let the fear build.

lines.zh: 站着，数一数这星球的气。
lines.en: Standing, counting this planet's ki.

lines.zh: 手指一抬，石子就浮起来。
lines.en: One finger lifts a pebble into the air.

lines.zh: 我看看自己的手，很满意。
lines.en: I study my hand and am pleased.

lines.zh: 在等一个值得我起身的人。
lines.en: Waiting for someone worth rising for.
So quiet. It bores me.

lines.zh: 尾巴尖一下一下敲着空气。
lines.en: My tail tip taps the empty air.
A pity my throne is not here.
Wondering whom to start with.
Ki circles inside me, pleasantly.
The wind snaps at my cloak.

lines.zh: 抬头看天，这片天空归我。
lines.en: I look up. This sky is mine.
The smile never leaves my face.

lines.zh: 手指敲着膝头，算着时间。
lines.en: I tap my knee, counting time.
Not worth my moving.
You dare look up at me.
Kneel or run. Choose.
Your power level is laughable.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，是恐惧。
lines.en: I know that look. Fear.

lines.zh: 你在发抖，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: You tremble. I see it clearly.

lines.zh: 说话前想好，我不听蠢话。
lines.en: Think before you speak. I tolerate no foolishness.
Your gear looks like a toy.
Your name? Never mind. It does not matter.
Stay still. Let me finish looking at you.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛是红的，看见了吗。
lines.en: My eyes are red. Noticed?

lines.zh: 手抖成这样，还握得住剑？
lines.en: Shaking like that, can you still hold a blade?

lines.zh: 你以为我只有这么点高？
lines.en: You think this is all my height?

lines.zh: 我打量你，像看一只虫子。
lines.en: I size you up like an insect.

lines.zh: 这颗星球的生物真没礼貌。
lines.en: The creatures here have no manners.
Breathe slower. You are too loud.

lines.zh: 想求饶，现在就可以开始。
lines.en: If you mean to beg, start now.

lines.zh: 我笑，是因为你确实好笑。
lines.en: I laugh because you are genuinely funny.
You wounded me? How novel.
This pain is nowhere near enough.
My clothes are torn. How annoying.
Tsk. I actually stepped back.
You dared to lay a hand on me.

lines.zh: 血？我很久没见过自己的了。
lines.en: Blood? I have not seen my own in ages.
I will remember that blow.
It hurts, and it annoys me more.
A scratch. Beneath mention.
You will pay for that.
That orb holds strong ki.
Dragon Balls? Hand them over.

lines.zh: 你们这里的食物，我看不上。
lines.en: Your food does not interest me.

lines.zh: 有能量的话，我倒想试试。
lines.en: Energy would interest me.
Raise that thing higher.

lines.zh: 我闻到一点有意思的味道。
lines.en: I catch an interesting scent.
What are you hiding? Show it.
Behave, and I may let you live.

lines.zh: 这星球的东西，我都想要。
lines.en: Everything here, I want.

lines.zh: 一块肉换一条命，赚的是你。
lines.en: A scrap of meat for a life. You profit.
You struck me. That will not do.
Back off. Do not touch my hem.
An insect hit a wall.
I am this small, and still you collided.
Move. My patience is finite.

lines.zh: 你的手碰到我的尾巴了。
lines.en: Your hand brushed my tail.
I did not even push, and down you went.
Once more and I will be cross.
That nudge is weaker than wind.
Steady. Do not fall at my feet.
A foolish question.
I have no need of that.

lines.zh: 宇宙里没有配得上我的人。
lines.en: No one in this universe is my equal.
My only interest is conquest.
Say no more. Revolting.
Only power is worth pursuing.
I never consider such things.
What is it you actually want?
My time is expensive.
Dropped something? Pick it up.
This seed is useless.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，只是为了踩碎。
lines.en: I pick it up only to crush it.
A crook of my finger pulls it over.
Coin on the ground. How base.
Let me see what this is.
In hand now, therefore mine.
This thing is mildly interesting.
Do not stoop. I will take it.
I have found you, insect.
Target confirmed. Begin.
I have memorized your ki.
Do not run. It only hurts more.
Locked on, insect.
This one, I handle myself.
I see the spot where you stand.
Interesting. You stayed.
The hunt starts now.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你最好动起来。
lines.en: I count to three. Better move.
Your ki stutters.

lines.zh: 让这星球看看什么是力量。
lines.en: Let this world see what power is.
The target holds still. Better yet.
I want your life, nothing else.
My tail tip is already raised.

lines.zh: 你被选中了，感到荣幸吧。
lines.en: You were chosen. Be honored.
He moves, and I answer.
My finger is already raised.
At this range, one shot suffices.
He ran left. I saw it.
I see his legs shaking.
A ki blast spins in my palm.
Let him run two more steps.
This prey is worth playing with.
I count his heartbeats.
He thinks hiding makes him safe.
From above, I see him clearly.
I wait for the breath he takes.
I want despair first.
A fingertip flicks, and the blast flies.
I raise my hand and a beam cuts through.
That was only a greeting.
Too slow. You cannot block.
My fist is heavier than you think.
The beam grazes his shoulder.
Blood spattered my sleeve.
Do not scream. It ends faster.
One shove, and he flies.
Small blasts, dense as rain.
Hit. Satisfying.
That kick will keep him down a while.

lines.zh: 这么小的身体，出手却极快。
lines.en: Small as I am, my strikes are quick.
See? That is the gap.

lines.zh: 收手，看他还站不站得住。
lines.en: I stop and watch if he still stands.
I have come. This world is mine.
Who woke me?

lines.zh: 这里的空气，我勉强呼吸。
lines.en: I barely tolerate this air.

lines.zh: 从天上落下，尘土都躲开。
lines.en: I come down, and the dust recoils.

lines.zh: 让我看看，这里有什么值得毁的。
lines.en: Let me see what here deserves ruin.

lines.zh: 一颗小星球，也是一个猎物。
lines.en: A small world is still prey.

lines.zh: 我叫弗利萨，记住这个名字。
lines.en: I am Frieza. Remember it.
Where is your god? Call him out.
I have landed. Where are the kneelers?
Too filthy here. I dislike it.
My army follows behind.
Fifty-three thousand? Enough.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里是我的领地。
lines.en: As of today, this is my domain.
Which of you dies first?
I smile, and you all panic.
I am still getting used to this body.
Very well. Let us begin.
That flame barely warms my hand.
An undignified landing.
Water, drowning me? Absurd.
The blast nudged me off course.

lines.zh: 这是什么把戏，居然有效。
lines.en: What trick is this? It actually worked.
So even I can go hungry.

lines.zh: 电顺着我的尾巴走了一圈。
lines.en: Current runs the length of my tail.
The void? I would rather not fall in.
